release_notes:
Proteus Patches v2.2.9 (pre-release, re-cut #3) - published 2026-11-07

Re-cut #3 fixes the on-device patch-time crash reported for Mereframe 0.8.4
(Manager 2.5.0 / Patcher 2.3.0, realme RMX5110, Android 16):

- Bypass native integrity checks: injected invoke-static carried six source
  registers, exceeding the five-register limit of the regular opcode form
  (35c). The inline-smali compiler left the dummy method unbuildable, so
  addInstructions threw PatchException "Collection is empty"
  (Caused by: NoSuchElementException at InlineSmaliCompiler.compile).
  The call now uses invoke-static/range {p0 .. p5} (same register sequence,
  range form), exactly the pattern the original wrapper used. Crash class
  eliminated. Repo-wide audit: no other injections carry more than five
  source registers.

Everything else from re-cut #2 is unchanged:

- #22 Amazon India patching error: AMOLED resource pass now writes ONLY
  android: framework attributes with a hard guard (Google Photos AMOLED
  patch carried the identical defect and was fixed the same way).
- #21 Amazon India video ads: NEW patch Amazon: Stop feed video autoplay
  (default off) - flips literal setPlayWhenReady(true) to false in native
  ExoPlayer/Media3 players. See docs/AMAZON.md.
- #5 Mereframe 0.8.4: bypass now calls the session JNI inside a real JVM
  try/catch in the extension (MereframeIntegrityHook) - the inline .catch
  was silently dropped before. Spoof install source Layer 2 resolves the
  Application family by walking the superclass chain (androidx parents such
  as LifecycleProcess are no longer missed). Signature-hook presence is
  enforced by the bundle verifier (two-tier: strict for nested dex
  payloads, advisory otherwise).
- Reddit save-flow stability: Remove ads Layer 3 constant return-void
  entry kill; Layer 5 kept ON by decision; off-by-default Reddit:
  Diagnostic crash log.
- 137 patch entries / 174 appearances. Unit tests 15/15. CI-built. No
  on-device verification yet. v2.2.8 unchanged. Latest full release remains
  v2.2.4 (see note: Latest currently resolves to v2.2.7 because v2.2.7 is
  flagged as a full release on GitHub).
